National Merit Medal Home Europe Asia America Africa Oceania Links Back Tags list Allies Research Back Societies Forums Back All updates Album sheets Reference Catalogue Search National Merit Medal Médaille du Mérite National Medal instituted on 24 May 1983. Medal awarded to officers and agents of the National Security Force for outstanding service or who were injured. Medal have 3 classes: Knight, Officer and Grand Officer.
